SELECT p.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED' THEN o.finished_qty ELSE o.qty END), 0) FROM mes_work_order o WHERE o.plan_id = p.id) AS wo_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.finished_qty), 0) FROM mes_work_order o WHERE o.plan_id = p.id) AS finished_qty FROM mes_plan p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.create_by
(p.plan_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY p.id DESC
